integrity: All numerical counts come from exhaustively replayable integer-defined maximal-clique enumeration; independent implementation reproduced all five counts. Historical articles are cited for context and are not represented as proving these numerical counts.
limitations: Exact finite census only for the 27-point ternary digit cube and full 216-character frequency grid. No statement about arbitrary real frequencies, higher dimensions, or a general modulus. The inaccessible 2011 source remains a literature priority risk.
title: Complete maximal Fourier-orthogonality census for the ternary three-cube
